run_pose_vis_source_stream: run pose_vis with camera sources using --sources and --resolutions CLI arguments
run_pose_vis_replay: run pose_vis to replay a recorded log file using the --replay CLI argument
run_pose_vis_profile: run pose_vis with cProfile enabled via --profile to generate a pose_vis.prof stats file
run_pose_vis_with_extensions: run pose_vis with enabled PoseVisExtension subclasses that register custom CLI arguments
run_pose_vis_logging: run pose_vis with logging enabled via --logging and configure --log-dir and --log-name
